programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 3
programme.desc: Sheriff Dan Tashtego joins forces with a group of monster hunters and ropes in officer Davis Tubbs to help stop the creature from its feeding spree.

programme.title: All I See Is You
programme.desc: Gina (Blake Lively: The Shallows) and husband James (Jason Clarke: Everest) have an almost perfect marriage. After being blinded as a child in a nearly fatal car crash, Gina exclusively depends on James to feel and ‘see’ the world around her, and it appears only to solidify their extremely passionate relationship. While the two enjoy a colourful existence living in Bangkok, their relationship is upended when Gina receives a corneal transplant and regains her sight. With her restored vision, Gina experiences the world with a new sense of wonder and independence which James finds threatening. It is only when Gina suddenly begins to lose her sight again that she finally realises the disturbing reality of their marriage... All I See Is You is directed by Hollywood heavyweight Marc Forster (World War Z, Quantum of Solace), and also stars Danny Huston (American Horror Story, Wonder Woman).

programme.title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
programme.desc: After a freak accident, a company executive turns completely invisible, goes on the run, and becomes hunted by a treacherous CIA official while trying to cope with his new reality.

programme.title: Zulu (1964)
programme.desc: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

programme.title: A Costume for Nicolas
programme.desc: Nicolás goes to live with Mia and Tomás, his loving grandparents, and his cousin David, who suffers from scary nightmares. Nicolás helps David overcome his fears with his vivid imagination, his sense of adventure and….. his trunk of fantastic costumes.

programme.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programme.desc: Maya is a determined little bee, but sometimes her determination can get her into sticky situations. When Maya accidentally embarrasses the Empress of Buzztropolis, she is forced to venture beyond her colony and team up with a group of mis-fit bugs in a bid to win The Honey Games and save her life.

programme.title: Dino Time
programme.desc: Three kids who travel back in time to 65 million years ago, where they are taken in by a dinosaur. AKA Back to the Jurassic

programme.title: Earthsea: Part 1
programme.desc: If you love Harry Potter, you'll love acclaimed fantasy author Ursula K. Le Guin's epic tale of wizardry and prophecy. Ged, a reckless youth is destined to become the greatest sorcerer that the mystical land of Earthsea has ever known.

programme.title: Earthsea: Part 2
programme.desc: Ged continues his fight with the shadow, while Tenar is accused of killing the mother. Together with his friend, Ged comes to Antuan. The king is planing to let the evil out.

programme.title: Somewhere Tomorrow
programme.desc: A teenage girl sees a plane crash and ends up chatting with one of the injured passengers, but later discovers that he was already dead from the crash.

programme.title: Kat and the Band
programme.desc: Seventeen year old, music obsessed school girl Kat Malone tricks her way into managing struggling band Dollar Days, pretending to be a band manager in her twenties.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programme.title: Grand Isle
programme.desc: A young father is charged with murder and must prove his innocence by recalling a very twisted and dark night of events.

programme.title: Casablanca Express
programme.desc: In 1942, a commando is assigned to protect Winston Churchill when it is learned that the Nazis are plotting to kidnap him.

programme.title: Clementine
programme.desc: Reeling from a one-sided breakup, heartbroken Karen breaks into her ex's lake house. There, she strikes up a complicated relationship with provocative younger woman Lana.
